title: The dead ExecutionAdptEventTypes block is gone from broker-sim-adpt (issue #46)
intended_outcome:
broker-sim-adpt no longer declares or re-exports ExecutionAdptEventTypes: the constant is deleted from services/execution/broker-sim-adpt/src/domain/events.ts and removed from the domain barrel's export list, and BrokerSimEventTypes beside it is untouched. Two conditions say different things. The first says the dead code is gone and the live constant beside it survived. The second says where the change landed, and nothing about whether it is well written.

Two paths, not the one the ask enumerates. The backlog note this issue carries names events.ts alone. Reading the repository finds the barrel at services/execution/broker-sim-adpt/src/domain/index.ts re-exporting the same symbol, so deleting the block alone would leave the barrel exporting a name that no longer exists. The declared scope names both.

And one path deliberately left alone, stated because it is a bound and not an oversight: services/execution/broker-sim-adpt/CLAUDE.md lists the fourteen event names inside a block whose own marker says it is generated by nx run event-processor:card-drift -- --fix. Editing generated content by hand is not the fix, so that file is outside this Case; its generator is the thing that updates it.

One more bound, stated for the same reason: the declared suite is the level-1 suite alone. It checks that both paths stopped naming the symbol and that the live constant beside it survived. It does not typecheck the workspace or run this repository's own unit tests, and nothing here claims those still pass.

This run was started by a line in the operator's own scheduler, with nobody watching. That changes nothing about what was authorized: a person read this Case and accepted it before the line ever fired, and the permission to publish one candidate is that person's act and not the scheduler's. Continuity records whatever the caller typed as the actor and says nothing at all about whether anybody was present, because it cannot see that.

completion_conditions.statement: The declared assertion "the dead ExecutionAdptEventTypes block is gone from broker-sim-adpt" passes. It fails at the revision this Case was opened against, so it can only pass if the work was done — in both paths, including the domain barrel the ask's own enumeration does not name.

params.test_name: the dead ExecutionAdptEventTypes block is gone from broker-sim-adpt

completion_conditions.statement: The delegated change touched those two files and nothing outside them — in particular not the suite that judges it, which the worker may read and may not change, and not the generated card in the service's own CLAUDE.md.
